question.text: A system changes from state X to Y with a change in internal energy measuring to 25  <math><mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">J</mi><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">o</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math> , by a reversible path and returns from Y to X by an irreversible path. What will be the net change in internal energy?

solution.text: For a cyclic process, net change in internal energy is zero. Change in internal energy does not depend on the path by which final stage is reached.
